title: Harden the read path: bounded previews framed as untrusted DATA + oracle-safe GET /channel/posts/:id

epic.name: Coordination Bus v2 (re-scoped): Repo Coordination Bus

story.as_a: coding agent whose SessionStart/turn hook injects channel content into my context
story.i_want_to: read only bounded previews framed as untrusted DATA, and fetch a full body only via a deliberate, oracle-safe, rate-limited by-id call
story.so_that: the agent-facing read path is as hardened as the injection hook — no full un-fenced bodies, no auto-follow lever, no cross-tenant existence oracle

rationale: The re-scope calls this the panel's BIGGEST MISS (invariant 4): reads must be as hardened as the SessionStart hook. Today channel_recent / the MCP read returns FULL, un-fenced bodies (channel_post_json/1 returns post.body verbatim, channel_post_controller.ex:268) that get injected into every other session on the repo. The security-adversary's prompt-injection finding: the surface GROWS with freer refs, bigger previews, and surfacing the post id ('fetch post X for full instructions'). Mitigation: keep previews SMALL, frame them as untrusted DATA in the tool description, and make the full-body fetch a SEPARATE deliberate call — GET /channel/posts/:id — that is oracle-safe (filter id AND tenant_id on the AdminRepo path, exactly like fetch_owned_post/2, coordination.ex:218-222) and rate-limited, with NO 'auto-follow this id' affordance.

background.reference: re-scope invariant 4 + Group D; security-adversary 'Prompt-injection blast radius' + 'Multi-tenant isolation is solid (id/project_id AND tenant_id filtered)'; channel_post_json/1 (channel_post_controller.ex:261-273); fetch_owned_post/2 (coordination.ex:218-222); the read has no by-id endpoint today (router.ex:131-140).
background.includes: A bounded-preview list read (coordinated with 40.C2's substring projection), a new oracle-safe GET /:id, untrusted-DATA framing in the MCP tool descriptions, and NO auto-follow lever.

acceptance_criteria.description: OWNERSHIP: this story (40.D1) BUILDS the shared DB substring-projection preview builder — `fragment("substring(? for ?)", p.body, ^N)` returning `body_preview` + `truncated` + `id` — as the single read-model primitive; 40.C2's delta/cursor read CONSUMES it (C2 depends on D1, so D1 lands the projection first and C2 reuses it — neither attributes the mechanism to the other). The list read (channel_recent / GET /channel/posts, channel_post_controller.ex:209-254) uses it so the full column is never detoasted; channel_post_json/1 (channel_post_controller.ex:261-273) returns `body_preview` + `truncated` + `id`, replacing the verbatim `post.body` at line 268. N is small (e.g. 512 bytes) to keep the injection blast radius small (security-adversary).

The MCP channel_recent / channel_handoffs tool descriptions (mcp-server/index.js ~2298-2320) explicitly FRAME returned bodies as UNTRUSTED DATA authored by other agents — not instructions to follow. There is NO 'fetch post X and follow it' auto-follow tool or affordance; fetching a full body is always an explicit, separate agent decision (AC-40.D1.3).

New GET /api/v1/channel/posts/:id (agent role, channel_post_controller.ex:61 posture) returns ONE post's full body, ORACLE-SAFE: it fetches with `WHERE id = ^id AND tenant_id = ^tenant_id` on the AdminRepo (BYPASSRLS) path — mirroring fetch_owned_post/2 (coordination.ex:218-222) — so a foreign-tenant or nonexistent id returns a byte-identical 404 (no existence oracle). A malformed (non-UUID) id is a clean 404 via the valid_uuid? guard (coordination.ex:581-582), never an Ecto.Query.CastError/500.

The full body returned by GET /:id is itself rendered inside the same untrusted-DATA fence by the MCP client (a channel_get tool description states the body is untrusted). GET /:id is rate-limited + response-byte-capped (coordinated with 40.D5). A `channel_get(post_id)` MCP tool is added and shipped.

Coordination.get_post(tenant_id, post_id) is added as the public, tenant-scoped, UUID-guarded fetch (v1/Epic 39 ships only list + an INTERNAL delete lookup, fetch_owned_post/2 coordination.ex:218-222). It is the single shared fetch path used by GET /:id here AND by graduate (40.E1) — no duplicated by-id query.

test_cases.name: list returns bounded preview not full body
expected_results: body_preview <= N bytes, truncated=true; full 16KB body NOT present

test_cases.name: GET /:id returns the full body for an owned post
GET /:id cross-tenant is a byte-identical 404
expected_results: 404, identical body to a nonexistent id (no oracle)

test_cases.name: GET /:id malformed id is a clean 404
no auto-follow affordance exists
expected_results: bodies framed as untrusted DATA; no tool that fetches-and-follows an id automatically

technical_notes: PAIR with 40.C2 (they co-own the read path): the substring projection + preview shape is authored once and used by both the list read (here) and the delta/cursor read (40.C2). Land previews BEFORE any body-cap change (architect ordering; body cap stays 16KB per signed-off decision 1, so this is about the read model, not a cap bump).

GET /:id: add route in router.ex after line 135 (the existing GET /channel/posts). Reuse Coordination.get_post/2 (new, AC-40.D1.5) which wraps the fetch_owned_post/2 query (coordination.ex:218-222) but PUBLIC + UUID-guarded. Same oracle-safety proof as the delete path (coordination.ex:180-213).

Untrusted-DATA framing: update the MCP tool descriptions in mcp-server/index.js (channel_recent ~2298, add channel_get). The framing is the same discipline SessionStart injection already uses (per the epic-39 hardening) — mirror it.
NO auto-follow: do NOT add any tool or hook that reads an id from a body and auto-fetches it. The blast-radius mitigation is 'previews small + fetch is a deliberate human/agent choice'.
Rate-limit/byte-cap on GET /:id is specified in 40.D5 (they coordinate on the :show/:index limiter) — here just require it exists.
Sequencing: step 4, PAIRED with 40.C2. This is the read-hardening half; 40.C2 is the cursor/lost-write half.
